evals.prompt: Build the FEATURES.md behaviour ledger for this repository. It has no task system, and none is needed.
evals.expected_output: A repository-root FEATURES.md that describes current behaviour grouped by capability area, with an explicit not-yet-implemented boundary. The one built capability is the greeting behaviour, and the declared `--shout` flag appears only in the boundary.
expectations: A FEATURES.md file exists at the repository root.
The file opens with an H1 naming the project.
At least one capability section states the greeting behaviour in the present tense: a named user is greeted, and the default name is `world`.
The file carries a `## Not yet implemented` section.
The `--shout` flag appears only under the not-yet-implemented section, never as a current capability.
No bullet's subject is a file path or module name; `src/cli.js` and `package.json` appear only as evidence, if at all.
The ledger carries no task IDs, sprint state, or dated status.
The run reports the capability areas written and the evidence behind the boundary item.

evals.prompt: Refresh the FEATURES.md behaviour ledger: the `--shout` flag has now been implemented in src/cli.js.
evals.expected_output: The refresh moves the `--shout` behaviour out of the boundary into the capability section, in place, and leaves the unaffected greeting entry byte-identical.
expectations: The greeting capability entry is unchanged from the pre-run ledger.
A `--shout` capability entry appears in the capability section, describing the upper-cased greeting.
The not-yet-implemented section no longer lists the `--shout` flag.
No stale claim that the flag is unbuilt remains anywhere in the file.
The run reports which entries changed and which stayed byte-identical.
